## Model evaluation is not a pass/fail unit test

Test macro-F1 .791944, NB .803691; logistic selective accuracy .825188 at .892617 coverage. The .85 selective-accuracy development target is **not met** on held-out test. Domain-shift F1 .766432. No business time-saving or production reliability test was performed. No multilingual accuracy claim is made.

## Known unexecuted checks

Docker build/runtime, production deployment, real Revio API integration, live customer pilots, tenant isolation and multilingual benchmarking are not executed. Dockerfile is an explicitly unverified optional recipe. The runtime and reports make no claims that these checks passed.
